title: Card rank mapping: 2 through Ace

credits.credit: Source-based vector graphics authored for this production; no third-party images or font files included.

tests.result: Run tools/validate_delivery.py after manifest creation; result is stored in review/delivery-validation.json.
Hash-locked originals retained; validate_pack.py output recorded in review/pack-validation.txt.

result.scope: All 71 posters inspected in eight 1920-pixel-wide review sheets, each poster at 640 × 360.
result.status: No obvious title clipping or composition defect remained at overview size. This does not certify every full-resolution motion frame.

tests.test: offline HTML, deterministic seek, every SVG text bounding box

tests.result: 39 inlined 1.0.0 faces in 3 src SVGs (126 px) replaced by the 1.1.0 studio.card() output at identical parameters (each recovered parameter set re-emitted the 1.0.0 group byte for byte); index.html scene table rebuilt; python tools/render/render_assets.py --id DIA-03 re-rendered every export; the offline browser check was re-run (evidence/browser-tests.json).

result.mode: Poster at 1920 × 1080 and 1280 wide, plus one extracted frame of each MP4 at both sizes, viewed by the worker.
result.scope: Card faces only; timing, layout and text were not re-reviewed beyond confirming they are unchanged.
result.status: All 13 spade cards at 126 px in poster.png and full-chart.png: 2–10 show the standard pip layout with the pip count matching the rank, J/Q/K show cap, coronet and crown with the court letter and one pip, A keeps its single large pip; every card carries the rank-over-suit index top-left and rotated bottom-right; the gold accent on the ace is unchanged. At 1280 wide (proofs/poster-720.png) the ranks and the pip clusters stay distinguishable and the 9 and 10 are countable.
